```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/project.R")
source("R/plots.R")
source("scripts/site-helpers.R")
snapshot <- site_read_snapshot()
zone <- "DK2"
summary <- snapshot$summaries[[zone]]
```

::: {.publication-hero .zone-hero}
::: {.eyebrow}
East Denmark · DK2
:::

## Plan your next flexible load

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat('<p class="lead">', site_escape(site_window_hero(snapshot, zone)), '</p>', sep = "")
```

This recommendation uses wholesale prices. Check the Radius / Andel consumer
column below before choosing an hour for your household.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_metadata(snapshot, zone)
```

## Today's quarter-hour prices

```{r}
#| label: daily-prices
#| fig-alt: "DK2 quarter-hour wholesale prices, with the historical median and Q25 to Q75 band for the previous 30 completed days."
plot_daily_prices(snapshot, zone)
```

The median and shaded Q25–Q75 band are the shared snapshot's wholesale profile
for the previous **30 completed Copenhagen days**, excluding today. Coverage
details show the available historical observations; missing intervals are not
filled with invented prices.

## Cheapest published window

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_windows(summary$upcoming_window, "DK2 · cheapest complete upcoming wholesale window")
```

The start is inclusive and the end exclusive. Cost assumes a constant 1 kW load
throughout the window and excludes VAT and consumer charges.

## Today's hourly prices

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_today(snapshot, zone)
```

Wholesale hourly values are derived by the shared analysis from quarter-hour
prices. The consumer column includes VAT and the variable **Radius / Andel
FlexEnergi scenario**. Fixed subscriptions are excluded. See
[price components](price-components.qmd).

## Recent and published prices

```{r}
#| label: hourly-overview
#| fig-alt: "DK2 hourly wholesale and Radius Andel consumer scenario prices over the last seven days and all published future hours."
plot_hourly_overview(snapshot, zone)
```

## Period averages

```{r}
#| results: asis
periods <- summary$period_averages
names(periods) <- c("Period", "Wholesale average (DKK/kWh)")
site_table(periods, "DK2 · wholesale period averages")
```

## Cheapest historical window

The shared analysis retains the cheapest complete eligible wholesale window
over its **six-month history**. This is historical context, not an upcoming offer.

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_windows(summary$historical_window, "DK2 · six-month historical cheapest wholesale window")
```

## Quarter-hour values

```{r}
#| results: asis
quarters <- summary$quarter_today[, c("TimeUTC", "SpotPriceDKK"), drop = FALSE]
names(quarters) <- c("Interval start (Copenhagen)", "Wholesale spot (DKK/kWh)")
site_table(quarters, "DK2 · today's published quarter-hour values")
```
